engine: Local MySQL dialect planner/formatter contract; no server required
case: Quoted multi-character MySQL delimiter across script consumers
contract: A quoted _finish delimiter adjacent to END terminates the routine as one planned statement, and a trailing SELECT stays separate.
Delimiter-shaped text and placeholder text inside a quoted routine string do not terminate the routine or escape parameter extraction.
Formatting retains the quoted delimiter directives and reparsing preserves statement count and the sole trailing-query parameter.

focused_test.command: rtk proxy cargo test --manifest-path linux/Cargo.toml -p tablepro-app mysql_quoted_delimiter_agrees_across_script_consumers -- --nocapture

clippy.command: rtk proxy cargo clippy --manifest-path linux/Cargo.toml -p tablepro-app --all-targets -- -D warnings

remaining: Other delimiter forms beyond the quoted and word-character cases, plus GTK MySQL-backed approval routing, remain open.
